`Sheet.js:403-408` `sync_v2()` calls `this.chat_v2?.unsubscribe()` right after `new ChatV2(...).live()`, but `JSONL.live()` is async (`Store.record_url(...).then(stream)`); a quick New session or toggle before it resolves may leave a stream open. Worth one headless check.

`rail.css` hides the thread with `display:none` and prepends the v2 box into `.ux-dictate-widget-card`, so v1 keeps running (and keeps its DOM) under v2; acceptable for a compare toggle, and v1 stays untouched as required.
